driver_archetypes.rationale: Standard compliant car behavior to match M1/car discharge headway (target 0.335s) and ensure correct lane positioning; increased tau prevents excessive aggressive overtaking that inflates delays.
Higher impatience and larger lateral gaps allow occasional early starts (M2/early/car target 0.0074) without excessive red-running; mimics drivers trying to 'beat the light'.
Very low tau and tight lateral gaps (M1/moto target 0.2463s) with right alignment to reduce overshoot depth and improve flow.
High tau and center alignment mimic slow riders who overshoot the stop line (M4/overshoot_share target 0.6327) and maintain a central lateral position (M4/lat_moto target 7.1m).

Custom1 base class enables queue_space_seeking to ride in lane 0 (wrong lane) to bypass queues (M8/moto wrong-lane share target 0.2131); left alignment biases initial position towards the cutting-in maneuver.
High tau/minGap ensures illegal left-turners wait in the box until opposing green ends (M6/approach/l/moto entry ~54s, M7a/n_waiting target 5.25 veh).

traci_rules.rationale: Increase probability and creep speed to match observed early-start share (M2/early/car 0.0074); applies to passenger archetypes.
Increased probability for motorcycles to creep before green targets M2/early/moto (0.1303); applies to motorcycle archetypes.
Higher base probability and swarm effect simulate group red-running to target M3/share/moto (0.09048) while keeping variance reasonable.
Lower queue threshold (35m) and higher creep speed increase frequency of lane-0 usage to target M8/moto wrong-lane share (0.2131).
Slightly longer release lag (0.5s) accounts for box geometry and ensures exit shortly after opposing green ends, matching M7a/release_time (0.28s).
Targets M4/lat_moto (7.1m); lat_offset 0 keeps the slow motorcycle in the lane center to minimize overshoot.
Very high probability reflects that motorcycles frequently squeeze past standing U-turners to reduce M9b/delay_blocked.
